correctness.rationale: For the row-generator cycle Q, positive holding times determine its stationary projector and a directly verified passage-time group inverse G. An exact rational-map expansion gives T(h)=I+12G/h+O(h^-2); summing G along predecessor-to-target entries leaves a strict negative nonadjacent-pair sum for all n>=4. At n=3 the zero-sum condition forces rates equal, and the exact circulant formulas are strictly positive; n=2 has a positive two-eigenvalue formula. For the equal-rate square, every numerator except one is positive and a one-sign-change quartic determines the unique threshold. Standalone exact tests corroborate 406 assertions; no finite enumeration substitutes for these analytical universal steps.

value.rationale: Arbitrary-rate directed Markov cycles are a natural nonreversible transport testbed, with stochastic nonnegativity physically essential. A complete unconditional classification for every positive rate vector identifies the equal-rate three-cycle as an unexpectedly fragile exception, proves an all-dimensional graph-geometric signed asymptotic obstruction, and gives the first failing homogeneous ring its exact timestep frontier. This directly sharpens numerical scheme selection beyond generic counterexamples or ad hoc finite instances.
